Horizon Dual Shade Fragrance Roller & Fo:
The Horizon series turns writing into a sensory experience. Each set pairs a fountain pen and a roller pen in a smooth two-tone ombre finish with a bottle of scented ink that releases a subtle aroma as you write.

  • 1 fountain pen and 1 roller pen, both converter-filled for consistent ink flow
  • Scented ink bottle matched to the colourway, plus a classic blue ink bottle
  • Metal body with a matte finish and chrome accents
  • Seven colourways, including Cool Water T-Blue, Morning Coffee, Vintage Rose and Wild Strawberry
